english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something that is main, principal, or primary, such as the lead guitarist.
Use this as the all-purpose choice for the main or primary person, thing, or role.
This is the all-purpose choice for something chief, principal, or most important, including the principal part of something.
Use this as the all-purpose word for something that is main or principal.
This is the all-purpose choice for something being main, chief, or most important.
This is the all-purpose choice for something main, most important, or most prevalent.
Choose this when “leading” means a major or important supplier rather than literally the one ranked first.
